about: Hand-written expectations for #11 (tests/test_issue11_start_period.py and tools/qualify_start_period.py). Invented incidents. The start is the first raw record in declared order (time, then Seq), not the first labelled activity; periods are half-open [start, end). S-UNTIMED has a record without a usable time, so its first record is not known. Never read by product code.
